findings.title: Node rejects the pod: it is for another operating system
findings.cause: the pod's spec.os.name windows does not match node kd-faults-control-plane, which runs linux; the scheduler does not compare spec.os with the node, so it placed the pod there, and the kubelet rejects it (PodOSNotSupported)

evidence.what: pod status is Failed, reason PodOSNotSupported
evidence.detail: Pod was rejected: Failed to admit pod as the OS field doesn't match node OS

evidence.what: the pod's spec.os and kubernetes.io/os node selector

findings.fix: Give the pod a nodeSelector kubernetes.io/os that matches spec.os.name, so the scheduler places it only on nodes of that operating system, or drop spec.os if the image is built for the nodes the cluster has.
